wiki.title: Wayne Harper
wiki.extract: Wayne A. Harper (born February 27, 1956) is an American politician and a Republican member of the Utah State Senate representing District 16 since 2023. Prior to redistricting, he represented District 6 starting in 2013. from January 1, 1997, until December 31, 2012, Harper represented District 43 in the Utah House of Representatives
